notes.title: Version 8.0
notes.content:
[h1]Room-List system is finally here ![/h1]

- From now on You can join or customize Your battle as You like with Your friends, bots, on favorite map, mode and with given player count !
 
- You don't need to have full room in order to start the battle any more.
 
- After finished battle, You will remain in Your room and get ready for the next battle right away !!

- No more groups - If You want to play with friends - simply join or create a battle room and invite Your friends there. Room with disabled "Auto Balancing" opt. lets You select team manually.

- While being in a Waiting-Room - You can chat with all battle participants on a battle specific chat channel!

Please don't forget to report any issues with the new system - I'ts very fresh and surely needs some tuning. 

Also, We have 2 new maps for You !!
- Prison Arena  (8 vs 8 Skirmish)
- Gym (4 vs 4 Skirmish)

Thanks for Your patience and good luck in battles !!
P.S. Prepare for upcoming map: "Winter train" - where You will fight on a moving cargo train ! ^^

Cheers,
Stan

notes.title: Update 7.8
notes.content:
Hi guys !

This is just a small update before major one in about a week from now.

This one includes:

- Character reset
   * You can now delete selected character and create it from scratch

- Wrong spawning position ( another fix )
   * There still could  be a chance to spawn in wrong position

- Getting out of map
   * most probably due to rolling - please inform me if this still happens

- Triggering drinks by typing in chat
   * Sorry for that stupid mistake ;)

- Curse filter ( in several languages )
   * Most of bad words are replaced by @!#$!# characters ;)
   * If You find some bad words in Your language that You think should be filtered - please report it to me - (facebook preferred)

- Car collision fix for CTB

I'm still working hard on the new battle arrangement system - please be patient few more dayz.

One more thing - I got many reports about speed hacking - players supposedly move at normal speed but hit 2 times faster than normal - if You could send me a short video of that it would be really helpful - thanks.

Cheers,
Stan

notes.title: Version 7.7
notes.content:
[h1]Version 7.7[/h1]

- Spawning outside maps fixed
- Personal Leaderboards up to 100 records
- Anti-Spam for global chat
- Deserter punishment for leaving battle in progress
- AI joins for leaving players
- Heavy weapon stuck after respawn fix
- Spectator after respawn fix
- Attributes reset for gold currency
- Screen BloodFX now renders at correct depth

Our top Priority for now is to provide new Matchmaking system. You will see all battles in progress plus battles in waiting state (joinable). Also, You will be able to create own rooms with every settings like: AI/ no AI, Map, Mode, Level Range, Manual or Auto team balancing, Waiting room time. We want to get rid of group system - instead You will simply join the same room and select teams. We will also allow to start matches in not full teams so e.g. Park 1 vs 1 will be possible. 

Please like our facebook fanpage - www.facebook.com/StreetWarriorsOnline and report any encountered issues or Your ideas - You will be rewarded with GOLD, Items, Administration rights and our gratitude ;)

Cheers and Good Luck in Your battles !!!

Stan

notes.title: Update 7.6
notes.content:
Dear warriors !

We've made a big change in the game! From now on, You will have all [b]attacks unlocked[/b] to feel the full and differential combat but You can [b]LEVEL UP[/b] every attack up to level 4 - The leveling can be done only for RESPECT currency.

We've also introduced option to [b]Select Different Combo Variant[/b]. You can set up to 3 combo variants and switch them during battle.

At last - there is also a change to blocking - From now on [b]You can't block forever[/b] !! - There is a block fatigue level and You need to keep an eye on it too ;)



Have fun :)

notes.title: Update 7.5
notes.content:
We proudly introduce FACE CUSTOMIZATION SYSTEM !!

All 12 character heads has been remastered to provide more realistic game experience. You can now customize some key face details but more yet to come !

We've also added more hit reaction animations to give You more realistic combat feel.

SWO has also gained language translation system. One language has been added so far ( Polish ), but 4 languages are in preparation ( Russian, Spanish, Chinese-S, and German ). We''ve decided to make those first basing on our current players population.

We are also during preparation of new game trailer cinematic and promotion materials. As soon as it's ready - SWO leaves EarlyAccess on Steam.

notes.title: Update 7.0 LIVE !!!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Warriors ![/h1]

Update 7.0 Is live now.

1. You can now select to add bots and wait limited amount of time for battle ( default option ) OR exclude bots and wait for real human players to play - remember that beating human players gives You more experience for KO.

2. We introduce new feature - Clan Wars !! Every player can establish his/her own clan: Specify name, logo and invite friends to play together against other clans !

We plan to leave Early Access very soon ( first weeks of October ). Together with full premiere, micro-payment politics will change so the special offer for the eternal premium that unlocks all items exceeds very soon.

Cheers !
Stan

notes.title: Update 6.7
notes.content:
[h1]We have a big surprise for You ![/h1] 

We've remastered all game lighting and most of materials. 
Everything now looks more realistic thanks to the real-time GI, Linear lighting computations, and HDR. You can see the results on new uploaded screenshots and our new trailer !!

The game has also been optimized to sustain better quality on weaker machines.

We've also introduced Steam Achievements and a Wheel OF Fortune mini-game after each battle :)

We are still working on "Clan Wars" system and "Training room" - Game tutorial. - It will be ready in version 6.8

[h1]Full release is coming soon and You won't be disappointed !![/h1]
